name: ASML’s Alpha Demo EUV scanner
description: ASML built full-field 0.25 NA prototype EUV scanners and shipped them to laboratories in Leuven and Albany for experimental development.

date.basis: Date or date granularity stated in the cited source.

events.statement: ASML shipped prototype EUV scanners to imec in Leuven and the College of Nanoscale Science and Engineering in Albany.
events.place_note: These are the receiver locations. The event does not date ASML’s factory assembly of the machines.
events.caveats: Prototype tool shipments establish research access rather than wafer production.

evidence.locator: Mass producing leading-edge microchips and Developing EUV lithography
evidence.supports: ASML dates the Alpha Demo Tool shipments to August 2006.

evidence.locator: The start of the EUV era and The next big thing: High NA EUV
evidence.supports: The receiving Belgian lab independently recalls its 2006 receipt.
A user confirms two Alpha Demo Tools at Albany and Leuven and describes development work at Albany.

earliest_record.rationale: The supplier dates the handover of two research tools, and receivers and users corroborate the year and destinations.
